info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Case Management API
info.description: The Customer Case Management API enables businesses to efficiently create and manage customer service cases. This endpoint allows authorized users to log new cases related to customer inquiries or issues, ensuring proper tracking and resolution of customer needs. Commonly used by support teams and customer service representatives, this API facilitates responsive interaction with customers by documenting their concerns and initiating follow-up actions. With real-time case management capabilities, organizations can enhance customer satisfaction and streamline their support operations.

post.description: This endpoint allows the creation of a new customer case in the servicing system. It requires the necessary details about the customer and the nature of the case to be submitted.
